hint.cartesian: Type y = …, x = …, f(x) = …, an equation in x and y, a point (a, b), or a = 1 for a slider.
hint.parametric: Type a pair (x(t), y(t)) and set the range of t under each curve.
hint.polar: Type r = … in θ (write theta or t). Set the θ range under each curve.
hint.space: Type z = … or an expression in x and y for a surface, x = f(y, z) or y = f(x, z), a curve (x(t), y(t), z(t)) or a point (a, b, c). Drag the graph to rotate it.
hint.trig: Functions of x in radians; the x-axis is labelled in multiples of π. Try sin^2 x or tan x.
